name: Zamir Zeigler
title: Media Server Op · Video Engineer · Projectionist
bio: Known in the industry as "Z", Zamir is a seasoned live events and media technology specialist with deep expertise across media servers, projection, and large-scale technical production. With hands-on experience spanning corporate events and major touring productions, he brings composure under pressure and sharp technical instincts to every show he works.

projects.title: Tony Robbins Live Events
projects.desc: Served as the dedicated Disguise operator for Tony Robbins live events, managing all media server playback and real-time content for high-energy, large-scale productions.

projects.title: Corporate Live Events
projects.desc: Served in virtually every video role across corporate-level productions — from media server operation and video engineering to projection and playback — delivering polished, reliable results for high-profile clients.

projects.title: Kanye West — Donda Listening Parties
projects.desc: Served as Disguise media server operator supporting Kanye West's Donda Listening Parties Tour, managing all media server playback for one of the most talked-about live event series of its time.
